chapters.title: The Sun God's Discourse on Self-Realization

verses.sanskrit:
ॐ आदित्यवर्णं तमसस्तु पारे सर्वाणि रूपाणि विचित्य धीरः ।
आदित्यमेव भगवन्तमेकम् अर्चन्ति ये तेषु परं प्रकाशम् ॥
verses.translation: Om! Having reflected upon all forms beyond darkness, with the hue of the Sun — the wise worship the one Bhagavan Aditya (Sun God), in whom the supreme light shines.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमहः आरोहन्नुत्तरां दिवम् ।
हृद्रोगं मम सूर्यो हरिमाणं च नाशय ॥
verses.translation: Rising today as a friend of all, ascending the northern sky — O Sun, destroy the disease of my heart and remove all my grief.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् ।
जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं परमं शिवम् ॥
verses.translation: The sacred Aditya Hridayam, the destroyer of all enemies, the bestower of victory — one should chant it daily. It is imperishable, supreme, and auspicious.
